title: CareerOrbit
summary: A career workflow platform exploring how job discovery, application preparation and review can connect in one workspace.
problem: Job discovery, documents and application tracking often live across disconnected tools.
approach: Customized and tested n8n workflows, configured Supabase tables and CV storage, integrated APIs and iterated on workflow outputs.
contribution: Workflow customization, Supabase configuration, integration testing, troubleshooting and documentation.

title: TechFarming
summary: A collaborative sensor-based agriculture prototype with supporting web-platform work.
problem: Understanding agricultural conditions requires a reliable connection between physical sensors and useful digital information.
approach: Worked in a two-person team across hardware, software and project coordination; contributed to later web-platform enhancements and application/data-flow testing.
contribution: Hardware and software collaboration, coordination, testing and web-platform enhancement.
